Title: Azure IoT Central jobs and metrics feature updates—May 2020

Body.Content:
Device health monitoring improvements

A new a set of metrics improves your ability to diagnose and monitor the health and usage of your IoT Central application and the devices connected to it. You can now see and monitor the number of devices connected to the application as well as metrics on device property reads and writes through Azure Monitor.

We'll continue to add more metrics and expand capabilities to include diagnostic logs, which will enable you to easily isolate problems and monitor your application.

 

Jobs improvements

The export your application feature now includes job definitions when you export from your existing application to a new application.

Additionally, the jobs results screen now includes a column picker that lets an operator change which columns are displayed. Selected columns persist across sessions and users.
